newsitem.title: INDIA: Five die in India fire, 14 oil tankers damaged.
newsitem.headline: Five die in India fire, 14 oil tankers damaged.

text.p: Five people were burnt alive when a fire broke out on Tuesday at a depot of the state-run Indian Oil Corporation (IOC) in India's northern Uttar Pradesh state, the Press Trust of India (PTI) reported.
Three people were seriously burnt and were admitted to a nearby hospital, PTI said. 14 oil tankers were also damaged.
Firemen battled for several hours to control the blaze in the Jhansi depot, nearly 400 km south east of New Delhi, PTI said. It did not specify the extent of damage to the tankers.
IOC officials could not immediately be reached for comment.
